'''''Gomesa''''' is a [[genus]] of [[flowering plant]]s from the orchid family, [[Orchidaceae]]. It contains about 80–100 species, all native to [[South America]].<ref name="ortia">{{cite web|url=http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=91261|title=World Checklist of Selected Plant Families: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|work=kew.org}}</ref>  The genus is abbreviated as '''''Gom'''''.<ref>[https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/plant-registration-forms/orchid-name-abbreviations-list.pdf Alphabetical List of Standard Abbreviations for Natural and Hybrid Generic Names], Royal Horticultural Society, 2017</ref>

== Species ==
